label: OpenArt Video Generation
description: Generate a video take through OpenArt's live MCP catalog without freezing a model or tool schema into the BONE.

prompt.label: Prompt
prompt.description: Exact motion-first video prompt sent through the selected live OpenArt generation tool.

model.label: Model ID
model.description: Optional live OpenArt model id. Leave empty to use the worker's current advertised default.

endpoint_id.label: OpenArt Tool ID
endpoint_id.description: Optional exact live OpenArt generation tool name. Leave empty to let the worker select a compatible video tool.

parameters.label: Live Tool Parameters (JSON)
parameters.description: Optional provider arguments validated against the selected tool's live schema. Do not duplicate prompt, model, or endpoint_id here.

start_image.label: Start Image
start_image.description: Optional local path, workspace-relative path, HTTPS URL, or provider reference for the first frame.

end_image.label: End Image
end_image.description: Optional local path, workspace-relative path, HTTPS URL, or provider reference for the final frame when supported by the live tool.

llm_instructions.writing_guide: Preserve an already-authored take prompt exactly. Write motion first, then camera and timing; keep dialogue and sound effects inline when appropriate. OpenArt's MCP catalog is live, so never invent or freeze model ids, tool names, durations, resolutions, or other parameter options. Set model or endpoint_id only from an explicit or live compatible selection. Put only live-schema-supported extras in parameters and keep start/end references in their dedicated fields.
do: Leave model and endpoint_id empty when no explicit compatible selection exists
Carry the shot's existing start_image and end_image references when requested
Let the native queue worker adapt reference names and validate parameters against the selected live tool schema
dont: Copy another provider's model, duration, resolution, or aspect options into this BONE
Guess a current OpenArt model or tool name
Place prompt, model, endpoint_id, credentials, or signed URLs inside parameters

x-genlock-surface.tagline: Generate a video take through OpenArt's live MCP catalog without freezing a model or tool schema into the BONE.
